brief.title: Propose a breakdown
brief.plain_summary: Pick a pattern for a goal and propose child verbs with outcomes, order, acceptance checks, one shared budget and stop rules.
brief.outcome: A private breakdown, or no_change when the goal fits a single verb.

goal.description: Pin of the goal or brief to break down.

alternative.description: Attempt label, such as a, b or c. Each label is a separate attempt.

pattern_hint.description: Pattern to try in this attempt, or any.

output_store.description: Store for the produced private nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Private nouns are readable only by the key that wrote them. Include each produced value in output.artifacts[].value with its pin so the requester can verify it through the task result. Never widen visibility or allowlist other surfaces.

outcome_meanings.breakdown_ready: The declared nouns were produced and every deterministic acceptance check passed.
outcome_meanings.no_change: The evidence does not justify producing or changing anything. Say why.
outcome_meanings.unknown: The question could not be answered with the permitted inputs. List what is missing and what would resolve it.
outcome_meanings.blocked: A required input, permission or capability is missing. Ask one precise question.

acceptance_checks.check: The breakdown validates against template.breakdown's schema.
The after graph has no cycle and every after refers to a child in the breakdown.
The number of children is at most max_children.
why_this_shape matches the chosen pattern's use_when.

required: Verify the pins. Check single-verb first; if the goal fits one verb, finish with no_change and say so.
Choose the pattern whose use_when best matches, or follow pattern_hint; different alternatives should try different shapes.
Give every child an outcome and acceptance checks. Children share one budget and never get their own.
Order children with after; never rely on a dependency finishing as proof that it succeeded.

execution.inference_allowance: Existing authorized worker allowance only. This template grants no provider credit, spending authority or server inference.

instantiation.rule: Replace each slot with exact NounRef pins, set the params, then recompute the idempotency key with scripts/build_packs.py --instantiate. Enqueue only with your own grants in a queue your owner assigned.

execution_report.purpose: Lets later runs of this template be fingerprinted and compared. It is worker reported, not proof.

summaries.problem: One sentence: what this run was asked to resolve.
summaries.input: One sentence: which pinned inputs were read.
summaries.solution: One sentence: what was produced or why the outcome was no_change, unknown or blocked.

usage.reason: Template only. Replace with measured counters or keep null with a reason.

fill_rules: Copy contract.input_schema and contract.output_schema unchanged, so every run of this template shares one shape fingerprint.
Add context_hash, environment_hash and toolchain_hash as lowercase SHA-256 digests when known; all five contract fields together allow exact matching.
Name the exact harness version, provider and model. Deterministic or human work records the model name as none.
Put what went wrong in an error block and in output.run_notes.went_wrong. The version-1 report has no fields for what went right, next steps or ideas, so those go in output.run_notes.
Leave token counts null with a reason unless the harness or provider measured them.

dimension_basis.reason: Tessera requires these axes, so each is set to its lowest value and the tier is unverified. No quality is claimed. Replace them only with measured values and the evidence that produced them.

notes: Instantiate this template once per alternative label to get separate attempts with separate leases and receipts.

brief.title: Lower a breakdown into task previews
brief.plain_summary: Turn one breakdown into ordered child task previews that an authorized requester can enqueue; this verb enqueues nothing.
brief.outcome: A private attempt plan with task previews and enqueued false.

brief.title: Compare breakdowns by downstream outcomes
brief.plain_summary: Compare two or three attempted breakdowns by what their children actually achieved: acceptance passed, children succeeded, time and cost.
brief.outcome: A private comparison naming the better attempt, or no_change when they are equivalent.

attempt_plans.description: Pins of the attempt plans to compare.

outcomes.description: Pins of nouns recording the children's actual outcomes and receipts.

output_store.description: Store for the produced private nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Private nouns are readable only by the key that wrote them. Include each produced value in output.artifacts[].value with its pin so the requester can verify it through the task result. Never widen visibility or allowlist other surfaces.

outcome_meanings.blocked: A required input, permission or capability is missing. Ask one precise question.

acceptance_checks.check: The comparison validates against template.comparison's schema.
children_succeeded matches the cited outcome nouns.
The attempts were compared on the same goal and conditions.

required: Verify the pins. Use actual child outcomes and receipts, not the plans' promises.
Compare acceptance outcomes first, then children succeeded, then time and cost.
Report equal outcomes as equal; pick the cheaper only when cost is known.

brief.title: Record the outcome in the pattern's success record
brief.plain_summary: Add one success entry to the pattern's record as a new version, with receipts, and propose a pattern revision only when evidence supports it.
brief.outcome: A new private version of the success record, or no_change when the use was already recorded.

comparison.description: Pin of the comparison, or of a single attempt's outcome.

success_record.description: Pin of the pattern's current success record version.

output_store.description: Store for the produced private nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.update_rule: Write a new version of the noun pinned in slot 'success_record' with its pinned version as the expected version; a version conflict means re-read and stop.
output_contract.delivery: Private nouns are readable only by the key that wrote them. Include each produced value in output.artifacts[].value with its pin so the requester can verify it through the task result. Never widen visibility or allowlist other surfaces.

acceptance_checks.check: The new entry validates against template.success-entry's schema.
trials equals the number of entries and successes the number with outcome succeeded.
The write used the pinned version as its expected version.

required: Verify the pins. Write the new record version with the current version as its compare-and-set expectation.
Append one entry with receipts; failed and abandoned uses count.
Set trials and successes from the entries only; never estimate them.
